item.title: Mount Rushmore of Detroit Lions Quarterbacks
item.description: Who belongs on the Mount Rushmore of Detroit Lions quarterbacks? A deep dive into Matthew Stafford, Jared Goff, Bobby Layne, and Greg Landry using career stats and legacy through the 2026 season.

item.title: Detroit Red Wings Reward Ben Chiarot With Multi-Year Contract Extension
item.description: The Detroit Red Wings have signed veteran defenseman Ben Chiarot to a three-year contract extension.

item.title: Detroit Lions Free Agency: 3 Centers Brad Holmes MUST Consider in 2026
item.description: With Frank Ragnow retired, the Detroit Lions must find their next franchise center. Here are three free agents Brad Holmes must target in 2026.

item.title: Cleveland Browns FINALLY Land a New Head Coach

item.description: The New York Jets are hiring former Detroit Lions assistant Brian Duker as their new defensive coordinator, reuniting him with head coach Aaron Glenn.
